display.purpose: The hero headline only: two stacked lines, the second wearing gradient-text-cosmic; clamp(2.1rem, 10.5vw, 2.5rem) under 768px.

headline.purpose: Sector page H1 (Lab, Timeline, Highlights, About); one word wears gradient-text-fire.

section.purpose: Home feed H2 ("Latest from the fleet"); the Launch Bay rail heading drops to text-lg and the commander card name to text-base.

title.purpose: Sim tile titles (1rem on mini tiles), flight-year headings (1.6rem), card headings, button labels.

lede.purpose: The hero's one-sentence lede and page intros.

body.purpose: Mission Log bodies (15px), tile descriptions (0.875rem), About prose.

readout.purpose: HUD strip stat values, profile-stat and cc-stat values (1.05rem); tabular numerals, counted up on reveal.

label.purpose: Sector labels with the 24px gradient hairline; 9px to 10px on card headings.

tag.purpose: snap-tag, sim-badge (9px on mini tiles), sim-tags, flight-type, tile-type; uppercase, 0.12em to 0.2em tracking.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: btn-launch at rest; sim-play uses 0 6px 20px rgba(239,45,45,0.35) with the same inset.

shadows.name: card-hover-ring
shadows.purpose: snap-card hover; gallery-tile uses 0 12px 40px black with a 0.15 nova ring.

shadows.name: tile-hover
shadows.purpose: sim-tile hover and focus-visible (mini tiles too).

shadows.name: thumb-lit
shadows.purpose: .lb-thumb.is-active with a #ffb45c border and a 2px lift.

shadows.name: horizon-glow
shadows.purpose: The planet horizon's cream rim and nova, violet, cyan atmosphere.

shadows.name: glyph-glow
shadows.purpose: Rocket glyph filter in the hero; 0 0 6px at 0.8 on the scroll rocket, 0 0 10px at 0.75 on the flight marker.

shadows.name: waypoint-lit
shadows.purpose: flight-year dot once passed; nodes use 0 0 14px rgba(255,138,61,0.85).

shadows.name: light-card-rest
shadows.purpose: Daylight glass-card, gallery-tile, segmented at rest.

shadows.name: light-panel
shadows.purpose: Daylight cosmic-panel; hud-strip 0 10px 30px rgba(30,41,59,0.12); sim-tile 0 12px 34px rgba(30,41,59,0.18), hover 0 22px 50px rgba(30,41,59,0.28) with an ember ring.

motion.name: ease-launch
motion.purpose: Every entrance and transform: reveal (0.7s), hero-line (0.9s), hero-scene (1.2s), sim-tile lift (0.35s), sim-preview scale (0.7s), sim-desc expand (0.45s), sim-scan (0.9s), rocket-liftoff (2.6s), gallery image zoom (0.7s), snap brackets (0.4s), page-in (0.34s), carousel-track slide (0.5s), lightbox image entry (0.38s, WAAPI).

motion.name: ease-toy
motion.purpose: Playful feedback only: horizon-poke (0.9s), icon-launch hop (0.6s).

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Color, border, shadow and small transform state changes at 0.2s (buttons, chips), 0.25s (cards, nav underline), 0.3s to 0.35s (tiles, waypoints, spotlight).

motion.name: counter-ease
motion.purpose: JS cubic ease-out for data-count-to counters (1400ms) and data-scrub enter.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: btn-launch transform, chip colors, mobile nav color.

motion.name: duration-card
motion.purpose: snap-card, nav underline, sim-tile lift, waypoint fill, spotlight fade.

motion.name: duration-sheen
motion.purpose: btn-launch ::after sheen sweep from -80% to 130%.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: .reveal opacity and 26px rise; stagger via --reveal-delay (100ms steps on tiles, 0/70/140/70ms on gallery).

motion.name: duration-hero-line
motion.purpose: hero-line blur(8px) + 28px rise; delays --d 0.05 / 0.15 / 0.28 / 0.42 / 0.56 / 0.7s.

motion.name: countdown-step
motion.purpose: T-3, T-2, T-1, Liftoff; the live T+ clock starts 1400ms after the last step (2920ms total). Plays once per session via sessionStorage.su-launched.

motion.name: liftoff
motion.purpose: rocket-liftoff to translate(34px, calc(-1 * var(--climb, 40vh))) rotate(9deg); flame-ignite 2.6s ease-out; launch-smoke 1.8s ease-out; is-instant collapses these to 0.01s.

motion.name: climb
motion.value: --climb = 0.47 × hero height (0.55 under 768px), in px, re-set on resize
motion.purpose: Liftoff distance follows the hero so the rocket ends in clear sky on any screen.

motion.name: flame-flicker
motion.purpose: Rocket and flight-marker flames.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.value: out 0.2s ease-in, in 0.34s ease-launch with 12px rise
motion.purpose: @view-transition { navigation: auto } cross-document fade.

motion.name: loop-nebula
motion.purpose: Three nebula discs drifting up to 7vw and scaling 0.95 to 1.15.

motion.name: loop-orbit
motion.purpose: avatar-orbit dashed rings (ring-a forward, ring-b reverse).

motion.name: loop-ambient
motion.purpose: Empty glyph float, footer status dot, hero sparkles.

motion.name: scroll-scrub
motion.value: in: 22vh window from 94% viewport, 30px travel; out: fade to 0.15 over 11vh, -22px
motion.purpose: [data-scrub=in|out|inout], continuous, one shared passive scroll listener + rAF.

motion.name: scroll-ascent
motion.value: rocket translate(70px * p, -0.95 * heroHeight * p); horizon translateY(0.32 * heroHeight * p); p = scrollY / heroHeight clamped to 1.3
motion.purpose: Launch hero scroll choreography.

motion.name: flight-marker
motion.value: marker pinned at 42% of viewport height; waypoints light when marker passes within 8px
motion.purpose: Timeline flight path.

motion.name: lightbox-slide
motion.value: out 150ms ease-in to translateX(-36px × dir) scale(0.98); in 380ms ease-launch from translateX(36px × dir) scale(0.98); swipe threshold 40px
motion.purpose: Highlights lightbox, direction-aware WAAPI on .lb-img; neighbours preloaded; plain swap under reduced motion.

motion.name: carousel-slide
motion.value: transform 0.5s ease-launch; frame height 300ms ease-out; swipe threshold 40px
motion.purpose: Post carousel .carousel-track and its full-screen viewer; transition none under reduced motion.

motion.name: pointer-parallax
motion.purpose: Hero distant bodies on hover-capable devices.

motion.name: pointer-magnetic
motion.purpose: btn-launch and btn-ghost lean toward the cursor.

motion.name: pointer-spotlight
motion.value: radial-gradient(340px circle at --mx --my, rgba(255,138,61,0.10), transparent 65%), 0.35s fade
motion.purpose: .spotlight cards and tiles; ember 0.07 on daylight.

motion.name: preview-boost
motion.value: 2.4x speed on hover, lerp 0.08; dpr capped 1.5; runs only while 5% visible and tab visible; scene box fit 0.72 of tile height (0.56 is-open, 0.92 is-mini), width ≤ 1.75 × height, centred
motion.purpose: Procedural sim previews (gravity, hydraulics, nucleus, artillery, comet fallback) keyed by slug in pickScene.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reveals shown, hero-line/scene skip, nebula and orbit rings static, counters jump to final, scrub/tilt/magnetic/parallax off, starfield static (no drift, twinkle, shooters), countdown skipped (is-instant is-launched, clock runs), flight marker hidden and all waypoints lit, sim previews render one composed still (40 silent ticks), tile transitions none, flame static at 0.95, view transitions none, planet poke disabled, carousel-track transition none, mini tile hover static, lightbox plain swap.

breakpoints.name: narrow-max
breakpoints.purpose: Bottom nav squeeze (64px centre column, 10px labels).

breakpoints.name: phone-max
breakpoints.purpose: Body padding-bottom 4rem for bottom nav; hero rocket 52px on a 78% / 66% track; far planet 40px top-left; scene-moon hidden; hero-title clamp(2.1rem, 10.5vw, 2.5rem); hud-strip 2 columns; lb-nav hidden; rail mini tile 150px.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind sm; Lab sim grid 2 columns.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind md; desktop nav; hud-strip 4 columns; masonry 3 columns; sector section padding 6rem; home feed top padding 3rem.

breakpoints.name: tablet-max
breakpoints.purpose: Legacy .hero-scene 210px rule; inert on the launch hero, which resets its scene to inset: 0.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind lg; home feed bridge (240px commander card | max-w-xl posts | 300px Launch Bay rail, asides sticky at 6rem; below lg the rail becomes the swipe strip above the feed); Lab and About sidebars.

narrative.northStar: Mission Control, played like a game launcher
narrative.overview:
Sherwin Universe is a 12-year-old's space program rendered as his own Mission Control. The screen is a near-black cosmos with a live starfield and three slow nebulae; everything that sits on it is either glass (a faint white film with a hairline border) or a lit instrument (nova-orange readouts, plasma-cyan focus, violet depth). The visitor lands mid-launch: a T-minus readout counts down, a rocket lifts off a planet horizon and keeps climbing as they scroll, and the sims in the Launch Bay are already moving before anyone clicks. The build refuses the boxed hero card, the equal-card row and the generic social feed: the hero is full-bleed and short enough that the feed shows under it, the home is feed-first (a three-column bridge: commander card on the left, the Mission Log in the centre under a row of tag chips, a sticky Launch Bay rail of live mini tiles on the right), and the Mission Log's cards behave like field reports (HUD corner brackets, `T-` timestamps, mono tag chips). The Lab is the full game shelf; on Home the sims are a rail, not a section.

Density is editorial rather than dashboard-dense: one big display line per screen, a feed that starts 2rem to 3rem under the hero and then breathes in 1.25rem card gaps, sector pages with 3rem to 6rem of section rhythm, and small mono labels doing the wayfinding. Dark is the default. The light theme is not an inversion but a "daylight cosmos": a tinted peach-to-lavender-to-blue sky with the same pastel nebulae turned up, white cards, and every glow either removed or re-tuned to a deeper ember. The nav stays dark in both themes.
keyCharacteristics: Cosmos background (`#050508`) that is drawn, not flat: canvas starfield with three parallax layers, twinkle and shooting stars, plus three blurred nebula discs drifting on 46s to 58s loops.

Fire gradient as the signature: ignition red into nova orange (into cream for text), used for the primary CTA, the active segment and feed chip, the nav underline, the scroll-progress bar and gradient headlines.

Feed-first home: the hero hands off to a three-column bridge (240px commander card | `max-w-xl` posts | 300px Launch Bay rail), both rails sticky at 6rem; on phones the rail becomes a snap-scrolling swipe strip above the feed.
HUD grammar: JetBrains Mono, uppercase, wide tracking (0.12em to 0.32em), a 24px gradient hairline before every sector label.
Glass at rest, glow on interaction: surfaces are near-transparent with hairline borders; hover adds a warm ring or shadow and a 2px to 4px lift.
One easing curve for entrances, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and a bouncy `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` reserved for toy interactions (poking the planet, the icon hop).
An authored rocket glyph (`#i-rocket`) appears in three places: the scroll-progress bar, the launch hero, and the timeline's flight marker.

Motion is respectful by construction: every loop stops off-screen or when the tab is hidden, the countdown plays once per session, and `prefers-reduced-motion` keeps the states and drops the movement.

rules.name: The Fire Ramp Rule
rules.body: Warm accents always travel red → orange (→ cream). A gradient that starts on nova and ends on red, or a warm accent that mixes in violet, is off-world. `gradient-text-cosmic` is the one sanctioned crossover (fire into violet into cyan) and it is reserved for the hero headline.

rules.name: The Nova Light Rule
rules.body: Nova orange (`#ff8a3d`) is the light source, not a fill. It appears as text on readouts, as hairlines, and as glow (`box-shadow`, `text-shadow`, `drop-shadow`); the only solid nova fills are the skip link and the "passed" flight node dot.

rules.name: The Cool Counterpoint Rule
rules.body: Plasma and nebula never carry a call to action. Cyan means focus, structure (dashed orbits, flight line) and category badges; violet means depth (distant bodies, nebulae, tile tints).

rules.name: The Deeper-on-Daylight Rule
rules.body: Every accent has a light-theme partner one to two steps darker (`#ff8a3d` → `#c2410c`, `#7dd3fc` → `#0284c7`, `#34d399` → `#059669`). Never ship a dark-theme accent on a white card.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where a number or a system label would appear on an instrument panel: sector labels, stat values, timestamps, tags, badges, coordinates. Never for headings, body copy or button labels.

rules.name: The One Gradient Word Rule
rules.body: A gradient headline lights one word (or one line in the hero). The rest of the headline stays solid white (`light-heading` on daylight).

rules.name: The Sector Label Rule
rules.body: Every sector page opens with a `.hud-label` reading `Sector NN · Name` (03 Timeline, 04 Highlights, 05 The Lab, 06 Commander Profile), 1rem above the H1. Card-level HUD labels shrink to 9px to 10px but keep the hairline.

rules.name: The Glass-Then-Glow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat glass at rest. Shadow and glow are responses to state (hover, focus, "passed", active), not decoration.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Colored shadows are always warm (`rgba(239,45,45,x)` or `rgba(255,138,61,x)`). Neutral depth uses black in the dark theme and slate `rgba(30,41,59,x)` on daylight. No cyan or violet shadows outside the horizon atmosphere.

rules.name: The Inset Highlight Rule
rules.body: Every gradient-filled control carries `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25)`; glass panels carry it at 0.08 (0.9 on daylight). It is what makes a fill read as a lit surface.

dos: Do open every sector page with `.hud-label` reading `Sector NN · Name`, then the Space Grotesk H1 with one word in `gradient-text-fire`, then a one-sentence intro in `text-muted`/`text-dim` at `text-lg`, `mb-12` before content.
Do build warm gradients red → orange (`#ef2d2d` → `#ff8a3d`, with `#ff5f2d` at 55% on fills and `#ffd08a` as the text end), and reserve `gradient-text-cosmic` for the hero.
Do keep surfaces as glass (`rgba(255,255,255,0.03)` + 1px `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`) and express state with a warm ring, a black shadow and a 2px to 4px lift.

Do use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for every entrance and transform (0.35s tiles, 0.7s reveals and image zooms, 0.9s hero lines), `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` only for toy feedback, and plain `ease` 0.2s to 0.35s for color, border and shadow.
Do give every new light-theme variant an explicit rule scoped `[data-theme="light"] main .component` (or `footer`), and pair each accent with its deeper daylight partner.
Do draw icons as inline stroke SVG (24 viewBox, `stroke-width` 1.5 to 2, round caps) or a sprite `<use href="#i-rocket|#i-satellite|#i-antenna"/>`; add new glyphs to the sprite in `base.html`.

Do stop any loop when its element is off-screen or the tab is hidden (IntersectionObserver + `visibilitychange`), subscribe scroll work to the shared `onScroll` bus, and provide a still or an instant state under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Do size sim tiles from their container (Lab rows `clamp(230px, 24vw, 330px)`, rail tiles 128px / 150px), never with `aspect-ratio`; the preview fits its scene into a centred box (0.72 / 0.56 / 0.92 of the height, width ≤ 1.75 × height) so the lockup stays clear.

Do move media with a direction-aware slide: a 40px swipe threshold, the incoming frame on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` (0.38s lightbox, 0.5s carousel), the outgoing on a short `ease-in`, and a plain swap under reduced motion.

Do write template copy in first person, plain and specific, in space-program vocabulary (mission, launch bay, mission day, T-minus, sector, commander), and title pages `X · Sherwin Universe` with a middle dot.
Do bump `?v=` on `main.css` and `main.js` in `base.html` whenever they change.
donts: Don't box the hero in a card, lay sims out as an equal-card row, or render the Mission Log as a generic social feed; the horizon-riding HUD strip, the feed-first bridge (commander card | posts | Launch Bay rail) and the field-report brackets are the shape of this world.

Don't add a standalone sims section back to Home; the Launch Bay is the right rail (a swipe rail above the feed on phones) and the Lab is the full shelf. Mini tiles carry a title and Play only, never a description.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for headings, body copy or button labels, and don't set a HUD label in Inter (the 404 kicker does this and is not the pattern).
Don't use emoji as UI icons; emoji belong only in owner-authored content (About loadout chips, snap bodies). Don't use text glyphs (`✦`, arrows) where an SVG should be.
Don't put em-dashes in template copy (HTML comments are fine); don't title a page with ` - Sherwin Universe`.
Don't ship cyan or violet shadows, solid nova fills (skip link and lit waypoint dots excepted), or a dark-theme accent on a white daylight card.
Don't hard-code sims in templates; tiles are DB rows and scenes are keyed by slug in `pickScene`. Don't draw a sim twice (static mark plus live scene).
Don't let the nav go light; it stays `glass-nav` dark in both themes.
Don't replay the launch countdown on every page load; `sessionStorage.su-launched` gates it once per session.
Don't add a new dependency or a build step; the system is Tailwind CDN config in `base.html`, `main.css` and `main.js`.
